name: Isles BOS
description:
Isles BOS is a modern, cloud-based business management platform designed to help businesses manage sales, invoices, inventory, customers, expenses, and financial performance in one place. Powered by Firebase, it supports secure user authentication, multiple businesses, staff management, real-time data synchronization, and business analytics.

**One Platform. Multiple Businesses. Smarter Management.** This solution enables seamless operational oversight across diverse organizational entities.
